messages.subject: Seeking a second mentor for keRas project
parts:
Hi All,
   Need a second mentor for the keRas project
  1. It is an interesting project to add scalable DeepLearning capability to R. 
  2. As Brian points out:
    • "Each project needs 2 mentors. One should be an expert R programmer with previous package development experience, and the other can be a domain expert in some other field or application area (optimization, bioinformatics, machine learning, data viz, etc). Ideally one of the two mentors should have previous experience with GSOC (either as a student or mentor)."
  3. We have a few good students who have expressed interest, but without a second mentor we can't proceed.
Would appreciate help in spreading the word and finding a mentor.

Cheers & Thanks
-<k/>
